mapper.select: SELECT mp.mpno, mp.mpcount, mp.mpstart, mp.mpend, mp.mpstatus, mp.mno, mp.pno, p.pname, p.ptype, p.pimg, TRUNC(mp.mpend) - TRUNC(SYSDATE) AS daysLeft FROM MEMBER_PASSES mp JOIN PASS p ON mp.pno = p.pno WHERE mp.mno = #{mno} AND mp.mpstatus = '사용중' ORDER BY mp.mpno DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER_PASSES WHERE MNO=#{mno} AND MPSTATUS='사용중' AND MPEND IS NOT NULL AND MPEND >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT * FROM MEMBER_PASSES WHERE MNO=#{mno} AND MPSTATUS='사용중' AND MPEND IS NOT NULL AND MPEND >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) ORDER BY MPEND DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM=1
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBER_PASSES SET MPSTATUS='만료' WHERE MNO=#{mno} AND MPSTATUS='사용중' AND MPEND <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
